units.name: Cover page
units.outline: Title and team members.

units.name: Executive Summary
units.outline: Problem, proposed design, headline results (NPV, ROI, payback), top risks and residuals, key standards complied with.

units.name: Introduction
units.outline: Summary of the problem, project definition and scope, host and context.

units.name: Proposed Design and Solution
units.outline: Concise overview. Links each decision to chapters 3 to 9. Anything in the client brief not covered later.

units.name: Candidate applications by option and AI-exposure classification
Professional boundary and the engineer's changing role
System Model
units.outline: Context diagram (components, flows, interfaces) and an assumptions table: ID, rationale, source.

units.name: Requirements and Design Alignment
units.outline: Measurable objectives, constraints, stakeholder needs, success metrics, ethics guardrails. Traceability table: requirement, design feature, source.

units.name: Resource Selection
units.outline: Short bill of materials (item, part no./version, qty, rationale, ethics and sustainability). Buy or lease, lead times, people and competence.

units.name: Risk, Safety and Ethics
units.outline: Hazards, analysis, controls, residual risk. Ethical risks: privacy, bias, fairness, duty of care. Register in appendix, up to 20 items.

units.name: Standards and Compliance
units.outline: Compliance table, up to 10 items: standard and clause, design feature, evidence.

units.name: Design Evaluation
units.outline: Economic, technical and non-economic factors. Comparison tables, up to 20 items. Say why this option beats the others, on which metrics.

units.name: Design Optimisation and Validation
units.outline: How the design was optimised and validated, with the evidence you judge appropriate.

units.name: Virtual validation of the haulage benefit
Conclusion
units.outline: A compelling argument and solid justification for the recommended course of action.

units.name: References
units.outline: Every source, data set and visual cited. Anything from AI must be backed by a traditional source.

units.name: Digital Tool Acknowledgment
units.outline: Which digital tools were used and how.
